verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a public RESTful API reference with concrete endpoint examples, such as listing and paginating items by level and environment, plus account- and project-level access token management, so the product can be driven programmatically. The docs only claim coverage of "much of the data" in the system, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec at any candidate path. missing for 10: evidence of full API coverage of product actions (e.g. resolving, assigning or merging items via API), a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec for agent tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
